correctness.rationale: For f_j=(x+jh)^3 the consecutive second differences are 6h²(x+(j+1)h). Vanishing for j=0,1 is equivalent to both N|6h³ and N|6h²x, and then all subsequent differences vanish. At p^k each step valuation s obeys 3s+e>=k, and its permitted x count is p^min(k,2s+e); the zero step adds p^k. Summing the geometric progression of valuation layers gives exactly T_p(k) for p>=5. At p=2,3 the factor 6 has valuation one, so constraints modulo p^k depend only on residues modulo p^(k-1) and every solution has p² lifts. Minimal feasible valuations give largest additive order via CRT attained at x=0. Independent full cubic evaluation of 4-point differences, counts and max order for N=2..90 corroborates; no finite-to-infinite inference.
